title: Machine Output Envelope
description: Universal envelope emitted by every machine-readable Evolith surface (CLI --format json, MCP tool results, REST), as ratified by core/ADR-0073. 'data' is success-only and schema-typed per operation (e.g. gate-evidence.schema.json); 'error' is failure-only.

success.description: Operation outcome discriminator. true requires 'data'; false requires 'error'.

data.description: Operation result payload. Present only when success is true. Shape is operation-specific and schema-typed.

error.description: Failure detail. Present only when success is false.

code.description: Registered machine-readable error code. The registry is append-only per core/ADR-0073.

details.description: Optional structured failure context (violations, paths, hints).

meta.description: Execution metadata present on every response.

correlationId.description: Caller-supplied or generated correlation identifier for tracing.

schemaVersion.description: Semver pin of this envelope shape on the producing surface. Bumps MUST be reflected in surface-compatibility.json (GT-174).

context.description: Verbatim echo of caller-supplied context. The CLI never persists or interprets these values.
